text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the application located at 179 and 181 Finch Avenue East. Staff are currently reviewing the application. It has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. Staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application with the Ward Councillor.

North York Community Council: 1. Referred the preliminary report (December 17, 2018) from the Director, Community Planning, North York District back to Planning staff so that the applicant has an opportunity to revise their application to fit with the Central Finch Avenue Secondary Plan.
